about: Test set for drafting the needs assessment from a spoken introduction (English). A null expected value means the person did NOT say it: filling it in counts as invented. Fields not listed are not scored. expertise_needs passes if all listed needs are present.

cases.description: Everything is said, including a budget in words
No business name and no budget: the agent must not invent them
cases.text: Hi, I'm Karma. I grow vegetables and keep a few cows near Punakha. I sell cheese and spinach at the weekend market. The problem is that shops pay me very little, and I don't know how to price the cheese. I only speak Dzongkha.

cases.description: Idea stage, technology, budget in digits, English only
cases.text: My name is Sonam, I'm a student in Kanglung. I have an idea for a mobile app that lets farmers sell directly to hotels. I haven't started yet. I need help building the app and with funding. I speak English. My budget is around 500 ngultrum a session.
